sloka: नमस्कृत्वा रामाय लक्ष्मणाय च वीर्यवान् ।सीतादर्शनसम्हृष्टो हनुमान् सम्वृतोऽभवत् ।। ५-१७-३२
transliteration: namaskṛtvā rāmāya lakṣmaṇāya ca vīryavān ।sītādarśanasamhṛṣṭo hanumān samvṛto'bhavat ।। 5-17-32

translations.english: Heroic Hanuman felt happy when he saw Sita. He offered salutations to Rama and Lakshmana at heart and covered himself (with the leaves of the Simsupa tree) and waited. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तदशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
